title: International Pantry Staples for Pregnancy Nutrition
excerpt: Oats, Greek yogurt, lentils, low-mercury salmon, eggs, leafy greens, and citrus — practical ways to build balanced plates
content:
## Introduction to Pregnancy Nutrition
Pregnancy nutrition plays a crucial role in ensuring the health of both mother and baby. A balanced and varied diet will provide the necessary nutrients for the development of the fetus. In this article, we will explore international pantry staples that are good for pregnant women, helping to build balanced and safe meals.

## International Pantry Staples for Pregnant Women
The following international pantry staples are excellent choices for pregnant women:
- Oats: rich in fiber, supporting digestive health and providing energy for the body.
- Greek yogurt: rich in calcium, protein, and probiotics, supporting bone health and the immune system.
- Lentils: rich in protein, fiber, and iron, supporting the development of the fetus and preventing anemia.
- Low-mercury salmon: rich in omega-3, supporting the development of the brain and vision of the fetus.
- Eggs: rich in protein, vitamins, and minerals, supporting the development of the fetus and providing energy for the body.
- Leafy greens and citrus: rich in vitamins, minerals, and fiber, supporting overall health and preventing digestive problems.

## Combining International Pantry Staples into Meals
To combine international pantry staples into meals, you can try the following:
- Add oats to breakfast with Greek yogurt and fruit.
- Use lentils in stews and soups.
- Cook low-mercury salmon with leafy greens and citrus to create a balanced meal.
- Add eggs to breakfast with bread and leafy greens.
- Use leafy greens and citrus in salads and juices.

## Food Safety Considerations
When using international pantry staples, you need to consider food safety to avoid health risks. Ensure that:
- Foods are cooked thoroughly before eating.
- Foods are stored properly to prevent contamination.
- Foods are selected carefully to avoid those that may harm health.

## Conclusion
International pantry staples that are good for pregnant women can help build balanced and safe meals. Try combining these staples into your meals and consider food safety to ensure health for both mother and baby. For more information on pregnancy nutrition and recipes for pregnant women, you can visit our [meal planner](/planner) or [read articles on our blog](/blog/topics).

## When to Seek Help
If you have any questions or concerns about pregnancy nutrition or food safety, seek help from healthcare professionals or nutritionists. They can provide you with specific information and guidance to ensure health for both mother and baby.
